dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Could you kindly get me a metal flower?

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: You're... the Lady Moonchanter... Are you also fond of these flowers I make?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A friend of mine is most fond, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lauma tells Richeza about what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I see. Never thought my work would catch the eye of a little bird.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Well, take one on the house — consider it a gift from me to that wee birdie. This one's particularly small, so it should be a cinch to carry around.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: On behalf of that child, thank you for your generosity, which I gladly accept.
